libraryLocation.row.detail: Move the library's EPUB files to another folder or drive
libraryLocation.row.unavailable: Library location unavailable — reconnect or restore the default
libraryLocation.row.recovery: The last location change didn't finish — tap to handle it
libraryLocation.title: Library Location
libraryLocation.subtitle: Only the library's EPUB files move; reading progress, notes, shelf and covers stay in the app data folder.
libraryLocation.unavailable: The library location can't be reached right now (the drive may be disconnected). These books can't be opened and copying imports are refused. Reconnect the drive and try again, or reconnect or restore the default location.
libraryLocation.recovery: The last location change didn't finish and left files to handle. Only files that change wrote are cleaned up; unknown content is never deleted.
libraryLocation.actions.hint: Choose a folder; EPUB files go into an app-specific subfolder inside it. After reinstalling, use "Use Existing Library" to choose the old folder again — each book's content is checked and nothing is copied again.
libraryLocation.pick.reconnect: Choose the folder holding the existing library
libraryLocation.blocked: Close the book you're reading and wait for imports, transfers and exports to finish first.
libraryLocation.hint.move: Each book is copied and its content checked; only when all pass does the library switch, then the old copies are deleted. You can cancel until the switch begins.
libraryLocation.hint.reconnect: Each book there is checked against the shelf; the library switches only if all match. Nothing is copied, and files at the current location are not deleted.
libraryLocation.hint.offline: On a removable or network drive, or an on-demand folder like OneDrive, books become unavailable while the drive is disconnected.
libraryLocation.tooLate: The switch has started and can no longer be cancelled; please wait for it to finish.
libraryLocation.running: In progress — please don't close the app.
libraryLocation.done.recover: The unfinished change has been handled.
libraryLocation.done.cancelled: Cancelled. The library is still where it was.
libraryLocation.done.cleanup: Current library location: {dir}. The last change still has leftovers to handle (a drive may be disconnected, a file in use, or an unknown file kept); handle them, then continue cleanup.
libraryLocation.error.busy: Another library task is running; try again shortly.
libraryLocation.error.unsupported-platfo: This platform can't change the library location.
libraryLocation.error.invalid-request: That location can't be used for the library.
libraryLocation.error.library-folder-una: The library location is unavailable; make sure the drive is connected.
libraryLocation.error.library-target-ove: The new location can't be inside the current library, or contain it.
libraryLocation.error.library-target-not: The new location already holds library files. If that's an old library, use "Use Existing Library".
libraryLocation.error.library-insufficie: Not enough free space on the new location's drive.
libraryLocation.error.library-verificati: Book content checks didn't pass; the library was not switched.
libraryLocation.error.library-recovery-r: The last location change didn't finish; handle it first.
libraryLocation.refreshFailed: The library location changed, but refreshing the shelf failed: {error}
